poem:
A mothers love,
A mother love is untimely can can be reached at any time,
A mother love is untimely, unconditional, pure and innocent like a new baby born in to this world,
A mothers love is untimely, unconditional,   pure, innocent and blossoms like a flower in spring.

When I speak and think of my mother or the love she shows tears start rolling down my round brown checks,
A mothers love has no end just live the sky has no ending or beginning so can we ever compere a mothers love?
A  mothers love can never be compered to any other love,
As it is untimely, unconditional, pure and innocent.

Love is a gift that never fails.
From season to season it gets stronger.
and from year to year, it grows.
Few gifts are better than love.

Through good and bad it prevails,
through laughter and sadness, it blossoms,
through weakness and strength, it endures,
Fewer gifts are greater than love.

My heart is a canvas, the colours they blend
A vibrant array of hues and their blend
A mix of red and yellow, purple and blue
A budding garden of dreams to pursue

My thoughts are a river, a swift-flowing stream
A journey of thoughts with a distant dream
A chance to explore, a chance to believe
A chance to be free, a chance to achieve

I am adrift 
Disconnected from the inside
Outside looking in
But it doesn’t appear as if anyone registers this at all

She doesn’t respect me
Disconnected from me
Outside looking in
But it doesn’t appear as if she registers this at all

To write a poem without a muse, would be a task I'd oft' refuse
For the sum of £3.75, you get what you're given albeit contrived
If you want a sonnet with lavish prose then be prepared to touch your toes
I'm not as cheap as some may be but good stuff is rarely free.

It's 2am and I can't sleep, can't think of meaning rich and deep
I sit in my creative hub, typing waffle for the price of a six inch sub
But there's always someone worse off than me
You're reading all of this for free.

Blank sheet, empty mind
Ancient sun warms my legs
And my soul
Memories flooding in

Her caramel eyes
Melting in the ancient sun
I don’t want to remember
I don’t want to remember

Tall buildings tower above my head
The citys hum echoes like a thread
Traffic and people always in a rush
In this concrete jungle, there is no hush

The lights at night, a mesmerizing view
A city that never sleeps, always anew
Endless opportunities, but also strife
Living in the big city, a chaotic life

I talk when I walk
I walk when I jog
Sometimes I am oblivious
Of the walking and the talking

I see them people
Sometimes people see me
They walk and talk
Sometimes oblivious of me

Whose dog is that? I think I know whom,
Their owner lives amongst the Egyptian tombs.
He gives the dog a tickle on his great big tummy,
Whilst the dog licks his face, oh so yummy. 

A dog is a man’s best friend, so full of love,
He would do anything for the dog, if push came to shove. 
Forever and always, together they will be,
Engraved in a nearby tree, their initials will be.

Welcome to the twenty somethings,
where so much is expected from us.
Feeling like you amount to nothing,
and questioning your life purpose in the bus.

Hope it gets better with time,
that all our dreams come true.
Hope we'll get to experience sunshine,
that we all get out of the blues.

Little boy, why ever so blue?
It was raining outside so there was nothing to do
If we use our imagination, we can make it a fun day
Now let's think of something to make us play

zip, cut! we can make a fancy dress
But don't worry about the mess
A pirate, A dinosaur, there's no end of what you can be
All's that matters, is it is done with glee

Do I?
Do I wish to be you?
You that is resting steadily
Among the humming bees

You that is sleeping peacefully
Without an ending dream
Do I wish to be you?
Who cannot hear nor see anything?

What a contradictory same world
The summer day is a place of promise
Brings hope of expectation and cheerfulness as you pass by others
Paves way for several self activities and to see others participate

The Winter day is a place of set rules
Brings calmness, steadiness, and concentrated look on the faces of others as you walk
Takes away the sense of creativity and wild imaginations
On the bright side, the winter is a time to cuddle and enjoy family time that I wish never ends

On a Friday party night,
The room was dim and the mood was right,
A girl walked in, 
All eyes turned to her with a grin,

She was like a bloom in spring,
And she made my heart sing,
Introducing herself as Esmee,
A Dutchie from a country full of tulips.

I'm not very good at poetry
Maybe because I never paid much attention to it
I don't know how to compose poetry
Does this count as a poem

I'll try my hardest to write something original
but alas I'm not very creative
I can solve maths problems no problem
Creating a poem however I struggle to do

innocent eyes full of acceptance
seeing soul to soul
without prejudice
without fear

where does innocence go?
where does innocence go?
the world is awash in tears
innocence drowning in hate

The clouds drift across the sky
Like thoughts across her mind
Even know she wonders why
She was left behind

The light dims and stars appear
She shivers from the cold
Her memories swept away by fear
And she suddenly feel so old

Feeling the comfort of sand between my toes
Relaxing and enjoying life just going with the flow
Feeling thirsty as I grab a drink
So many life decisions as I stand there and think

In the background you can hear the breeze
Still standing there thinking about what I want and what I need
Waves crashing the rocks and the shore
Thinking about how much time I have left and wish I had more

The night has a thousand eyes,
And the day just one;
Yet the light of the bright world fades
With the dying sun.
The mind has a thousand eyes,
And the heart but one:
Yet the light of a whole life dwindles
When love is done.

The world spins on 
you feel like a rat in a wheel
It produces life, it takes life
It remains indifferent to how you feel.

The sun rises then the sun sets
The moon shines on and you try to forget
as you grow older and closer to death
you feel like you have not started to really live yet.

The ragged fells loom above, 
The deep, cold, and gloomy lake.
Wind whistles through the trees,
In an otherwise silent place.

The water crashes upon the banks, 
As nature takes its turn. 
The never-ending beauty of the Lakes, 
Safe from mankind's reach.

What is time
We don't have enough
Or do we have too much
Time will tell

Time is indefinite
But not for us
Are we the present, are we the past
As a species, we are not the future

Everyday life comes with a lesson that no one was ready to learn.
A lesson for the young and the old, a lesson that breaks hearts.
Everyday someone dies it's a lesson that nobody is willing to learn the lesson.
Everyday someone is born its a lesson ,to be happy of.

Lesson, who wants to learn such a painful lesson.
A lesson of feeling the grief of loosing your child.
Who learns this lesson an easy way ,l would ask how they did it.
Who can learn to accept death the easy way,please show me.

Whose dog is that
I think I know 
Full of joy
I cry hello

The dog is gentle 
The dog is kind
The best in the world 
The dog is mine

Whose hat is that? I think I know.
Its owner is quite happy though.
Full of joy like a vivid rainbow,
I watch him laugh. I cry hello.

He gives his hat a shake,
And laughs until her belly aches.
The only other sound's the break,
Of distant waves and birds awake.

This woman's hands that stroke her baby's head
and comfort him with tender loving touch
So gentle and giving so much to this new life within her care
are as a calm and silent prayer in a dark bewildering world

Yet these hands have also fought with stallion bold and wild
mastered a creature, foam mouthed with quivering flesh,
and then with mild calm stroke, and quiet soothing voice,
have tamed and eased the fear inside the beast.

This task frightens me,
It exposes my weaknesses,
It highlights my shortcomings,
I am not creative.

The task is rather simple,
I did not think it would be,
I am proud to claim,
I can be creative.

Every cloud that crosses the sky
Is from the past and far away
Every breath of wind I feel 
Makes me feel happy and alive today

Every wave upon the sea
Comes toward me on the beach
I cannot feel the power within
Even with my longest reach

Standing tall for the world to see
It feels like everyone is staring at me
Topped with green leaves and stood on a brown trunk
Etched with carvings from couples in love

As the seasons change, so do I
Green turns to orange to brown
As it gets colder, I lose my leaf crown
Crisp underfoot and cold on top

To be productive is to be successful 
One must always strive for success 
Without hard work goals are unobtainable
Lack of growth leads to stagnation

To be unproductive is to be chaotic
One must never be chaotic
Doing the bare minimum no goal will be made
Stagnation leads to ruin

In the dark and heavy dead of night
When I yearn for sleep with all my might
I think about the disconnected
Days of painless ease selected

The cry from out within the black
Drags my weary mind straight back
That baby boy who spelled the end
For him my love will never end

It's  a Wednesday morning,
So What should I do.
Maybe write a poem, 
A poem for you!

It's not that long,
Its kind of short.
But even so,
I gave it some thought!

Running through the fields,
The fields of my disappear
Running through the fields,
With darkness in the air.

Feeling so haunted,
my legs are running out
Feeling so haunted,
In a world full of doubt.

The sky is so blue, so bright and so clear
The sun is so warm, I'm glad to be here
The birds they all sing, a beautiful sound
The trees they all dance, they move all around

The clouds are all gather, they form in the sky
The wind all blows, like a lullaby
My heart is so full, I'm filled with delight
I'm so lucky to see, this amazing sight

Verdant meadows, lush and green,
Grass so tall, like a natural screen,
A sky of blue, not a single cloud,
The sun's warmth, so gentle and loud.

A gentle breeze, a whisper in the air,
The birds, singing, a sweet melody they share,
Trees, so tall, reaching for the sky,
Nature's beauty, no one can deny.

Steve is big, Steve is strong,
Steve is impatient, he doesn't like to wait for long.

Steve is thoughtful, Steve is kind.
Steve is considerate, he always has others in mind.

Steve is funny, Steve likes to joke,
Steve is a prankster, he's a humorous bloke.

Steve is brave, Steve doesn't do fear.
Steve is protective, he'l look out for you when near.

I am unique and creative
My creativity is my pride
With it I shall never lack
It isy biggest asset

I am self sufficient today,
Because of my creativity
Oh creativity, you  are the cornerstone 
of human development

i know i am alive
for i feel the sting of the needles breath
marked for life 
it is me that you see

tears and time roll
through sadness and joy 
marked for life 
it is me that you see

The fuzzy caterpillar looked up into the sky.
He saw fluffy clouds that looked really far away.
That looks like a soft place to take a nap, he thought.
He climbed a tree and took a nap under a branch to rest.

When the caterpillar woke up, he had sprouted wings and changed colors.
His body was so much lighter and free.
Look at me!, he said gleefully.
The butterfly began flying to rest on the fluffy cloud.

I searched to find the meaning of life,
My purpose my mission my guiding light,
Though the voyage was long and the journey was dark,
I persevered on thinking I was smart.

The journey was endless no clarity was in sight,
Until I met the one who formed day and night,
It was then I found peace in my life's existence,
That I was made to be of service.

I love thee, most definitely, most truly 
Our love encompasses us;
Surpassing human comprehension, 
Demanding all attention, retention. 

My heart aches pining after such a love, 
My heart, mind and soul are with you, 
My thoughts echo in your remembrance, 
Yet you are not with me.

Towering trees have their arms held high,
Like they're reaching for the sky.
Their roots are deep, their trunks are real strong,
They've been standing long, they ain't doing any wrong.

Their leaves dance softly in the air,
Making music everywhere.
Oh, these trees, they're great,
Symbol of life, we can all relate.

Love is a thing that's hard to tell,
It makes me feel all sorts of swell,
My heart goes boom, and my mind goes blank,
It's like a fire that's hard to bank.

I don't know much about the ins and outs,
But when I see you, my heart just shouts,
I feel so happy, I feel so right,
Love is like a beam of sunlight bright.

Writing a poem on the net
How i got here? I forget!
Do i make it rhyme?
To not would be a crime

8 lines of it they need,
to them i shall concede.
Hopefully its fine,
this short poem of mine.

My mind is racing
Nobody is complaining
The wheels are turning
But nobody is moving

Riding without a care 
On my bicycle with some flair
In Sudan the sky is high 
I don't want to say goodbye

It's early in the winter time
Cold, dark and bleak and
I'm on prolific to make a dime
Is this the way it should be

Always chasing after money
Lonely, desolate and bleak and
I need life to turn sunny
Is this the way it needs to be

I know what to do
But yet I still won't
Or maybe I can't
Is that really my fault

Try as I might
I think I'm just scared
Of what's round the corner
My mistakes laid bare

winter is like, really frigid
everything's white, can't believe it
no more leaves, they all fell down
grey sky, no sun to be found

snow is falling, quite a sight
covering everything very bright
makes me feel all cozy though
winter wonderland, behold!

The cat's asleep upon my lap,
He purrs away with rhythmic tap,
I try to move, he digs in deep,
Said cat has claimed me as his keep.

I try to stand, he won't let go,
I'm stuck here now, don't you know,
This feline fiend, my captive king,
Forever in his claws, I sing.

Love Is Beautiful

I never believed in the word before in my life you came in my life and brought me sunshine
I doubted the words of romance in my life before, i doubt the thought from my brain
I was under the lights of seduction that any advice seems like distraction to me 
I was lost in a forest with no way out until the sunshine showed me the way

Did he find the way into my heart, oh boy, o boy, oh boy, oh boy, oh boy yes he did
Some don't seem to get why these feelings are blossoming between someone like you and I
We are more than trophies, just piece of games and opportunities to hunt
Our love story comes baptised as a tender gesture of goodwill towards our hearts and spirits
Oh what a beautiful thing!!!

The world is a stage,
And we are all actors.
We play our parts,
And then we exit.

Some of us are stars,
And some of us are supporting actors.
But we all have a role to play,
And we all have a story to tell.

So let's make the most of our time on stage,
And let's tell our stories with passion and conviction.
Let's make the world a better place,
One story at a time.
